title: Albumin/globulin ratio adds no established grip-strength prediction beyond its constituents: a locked two-release NHANES test
abstract: In adults from NHANES2011–2012(source n=4305) and separately sampled2013–2014(target n=4850),adding albumin/globulin ratio to a flexible constituent-adjusted model did not meet the prespecified incremental-prediction criterion for combined grip strength. Target weighted MSE gain was +0.004778kg²(source-and-target PSU-refit95%interval [-1.503085,+0.680582]);positive favors augmentation. This model-specific negative test is not equivalence or evidence against albumin physiology;no new physiological signal or clinical utility is established.
